original_observed_failure.scope: Original full AppServer suite; no new reproduction was run by this review. The same fixture-owned command marker remained observable after the original five-second disconnect observation.

static_trace.finding: connection_closed removes this connection's sessions and sends their existing Terminate control; run_command forwards it to the owned ProcessHandle.
On Linux the original pipe terminator addresses the recorded original process group. The original waiter observes and reaps the immediate child.
request_terminate consumes the terminator and discards the kill result. A successful control enqueue is not by itself evidence that the whole descendant tree exited.

unresolved: The retained failure has no kill return value or original parent-process identity trace that uniquely establishes why descendants remained.
Process-group signal success and immediate-child exit cannot be substituted for complete process-tree retirement or global recovery reserve.
recommended_product_boundary: Preserve original ownership and cancellation identity, propagate actual termination errors and use a verified task-tree containment/reaping boundary before claiming retirement. The native organ work needs its own explicit process-tree memory and independent recovery accounting.
